Commentary.Commentary: Right then. Pakistan have finally won against a competitive team in ODIs. We now head back to Dubai for the third and final match at 3 pm local (1100 GMT). ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Victorious Pakistan captain, Sarfraz Ahmed, says that it was a complete team performance in this game. On the string of losses against New Zealand, Ahmed says that he believed that the team could make a comeback and it did. Feels happy that Pakistan have plenty of new-ball bowlers. On Imam, the skipper says that the player is hopefully in good shape. On the batting, Sarfraz praises Fakhar for playing his shots and shutting new Zealand out of the game. On the bowling, Ahmed reckons that the team did extremely well in the middle overs and made good use of the reverse swing. On the final game in Dubai, Sarfraz hopes that Pakistan pull off a series win.

New Zealand skipper, Kane Williamson, admits that the runs were not enough on the board on the surface. Feels the bowlers tried really hard but it was too difficult. Says that there a few things they need to improve in and they need to build on from the win in Dubai. On the wicket, he feels that it was pacey and under lights, it skidded even more. Says that playing the decider is always exciting and both teams have been in this scenario plenty of times in the past and each would be geared up for the same.

SHAHEEN AFRIDI HAS BEEN NAMED THE MAN OF THE MATCH. Afridi is feeling great that in two games, his performance has been great. Says that in this match, initially, he felt that he was not able to bowl at all but then came back strongly. Says that he is lucky to be able to take learnings from the seniors.

Zaman and Imam made full use of these advantages and had a good stand upfront, before the latter got hit and was taken off the field. Then, Babar Azam joined Fakhar and the duo added 101 but after that, things slowed down a touch, though Pakistan were always in control. Fakhar was unlucky in missing out on his century but otherwise a pretty decent effort from Pakistan. This is their first win after 12 losses on the trot to the Kiwis. Please stay tuned for the presentation...

In the run chase, a couple of things came to Pakistan's aid. Dew was around and hence, the bowlers could not grip the ball properly. And there was no swing, hence Boult was negated. There was no spin either. And compared to Dubai, this pitch was not slower in nature.

Pakistan did the basics right. Stuck to their lines and lengths and did not allow the Kiwis to cut loose. Then, when reverse swing came into play, they choked the Black Caps further, restricting them to 209. Shaheen Afridi took 4 wickets but the real  choke was applied by the spinners who bowled 25 overs between them.
We have a decider. Pakistan were far too good tonight. New Zealand did win the toss but it did not prove to be an advantage for them.

FOUR! Pakistan win by 6 wickets! With 57 balls to spare. The series is eventually levelled. A short ball outside off, Hafeez waits for the ball to com to him and steers it past short third man for a boundary!
Landed around off, defended from the crease.
On middle and leg, flicked towards square leg.
POWERPLAY 3 TIME. Didn't think this time would arrive. Anyways, 5 fielders allowed outside the ring but Williamson ain't bothered.
Full again, watchfully defended. A MAIDEN!
Full and outside off, blocked towards point.
Outside off, pushed towards point.
On a length outside off, punched towards cover.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Full toss outside off, driven towards mid off.
A short ball on middle, Hafeez mistimes his pull towards short mid-wicket.
Landed outside off, pushed towards point.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Landed on a length outside off, played through point for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Tim Southee is back.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a couple.
The batsman manages only a bottom edge on that one.
Dropped short, pulled straight to short mid-wicket.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Shadab Khan is in.
OUT! Caught behind! Sodhi manages to get a wicket now. Short and outside off, Sarfraz looks to cut but only manages a thin edge. Nice take by Latham.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Ish Sodhi is back on. Will this be the last over of the match?

DROPPED! Tough chance. But that is why a man was placed there. A short ball, Hafeez pulls it towards leg gully where Tim Southee leaps but the ball brushes his fingertips and goes towards fine leg. A single taken.
FOUR! Fine shot. Dropped short, pulled through square leg for a boundary!

Outside off, SA punches this down the ground. There is no mid on or mid off.  The man at cover, the bowler and the man at mid-wicket get into a 3-way race towards long off. The cover fielder gets to it first. Three runs taken.
That is a jaffa. A short ball, around off, Ahmed feels for it, then tries to leave it go but is late and gets beaten. He looks at the square leg umpire for the wide call but it does not come.
A short ball, pulled past leg gully towards long leg for a single.
Short and outside off, Hafeez punches this through the covers and finds the gap. Two runs taken.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
FOUR! Bad line, full and down the leg side, Ahmed tickles it past the keeper to the fine leg fence!
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
WIDE. A bouncer, Hafeez ducks and Latham leaps to collect.
On a length outside off, Sarfraz steers it towards third man for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Around off, solidly defended.
A short ball, around middle, Ahmed looks to pull but misses. The ball lobs in the air and the keeper tales it and appeals, but the umpire shakes his head. No bat involved. Only the shoulder.
Short and outside off, Sarfraz looks to cut but gets a bottom edge. The ball rolls away to the off side.
Length ball outside off, flayed through point for a run.
Landed outside off, steered towards short third man.
WIDE. Wide down the leg side, No trouble at all for the batsman. The umpire has signalled a wide.
A short ball outside off, punched towards cover for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a couple.
Outside off, a fish and a miss.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Excellent yorker on middle, well dug out.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, slashed down to third man for a single.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Sarfraz Ahmed walks in at number 6, replacing Malik.

OUT! That is an outstanding catch! Boy o boy. Time reversed. History has repeated itself. 2001, Mumbai, Sachin Tendulkar pulled a short ball from Mark Waugh onto Justin Langer at short leg. The ball lobbed off his shoulder and Ricky Ponting at short mid-wicket dived to his right and took a fantastic catch. Now, come back to present. The bowler is Lockie Ferguson. The batsman is Shoaib Malik. The length is again short. The shot is again the pull. Here too, the ball goes to short leg. The fielder here is Henry Nicholls. He too, like Langer, gets hit on the left shoulder. Again, the ball lobs in the air. Now, there is a slight difference. There, Ponting dived to his right. Here, Ish Sodhi came charging in from short mid-wicket and slid across to take the catch. Malik did not want to go but the umpire sends him on his way. Amidst all this, Nicholls is perfectly fine!
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
ANOTHER WIDE. This is for height. A short ball, Malik lets it go.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Outside off, Malik punches it through the covers for three.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Gets across his stumps and looks to flick but misses. No wide given and Malik is not happy.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads for a single.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
WIDE. A bouncer, around off, Hafeez ducks.
Down the leg side, flicked away for a run.
Down the leg side, flicked towards fine leg for a single.
Drinks! Pakistan are in cruse control here. No quick wickets fell but the damage had been done. Don't see any door entry for the visitors from here. Also, Trent Boult will bowl after the break.
FOUR! Back of a length ball outside off, Malik cuts it through covers. No fielder there and it races away to the fence.
Wide down the leg side, the batsman leaves it alone. The umpire has signalled a wide.
The professor does well to stand tall and play that short delivery.
Short ball over the stumps, Malik with his eyes closed looks to tuck it away but gets a leading edge which falls ahead of him. Lucky escape.
The short ball ploy from Ferguson continues. Hafeez cuts it over point and gets to the other end.
Back of a length ball outside off, Hafeez jumps and cuts it to backward point.
On a good length around off, cut through cover-point. Easy two taken.
No pressure. Outside off, cut to the man at point.
On off again, driven to covers.
Length on off, Malik taps it with soft hands.
Short again on off, pulled through square leg to rotate strike.
Outside off, cut away aerially through backward point for one.
Short ball on leg, pulled away to deep square leg for just one.
Defended off the back foot by Hafeez.
Shoaib Malik walks out next.

OUT! Two in the over from Ferguson. Bangs it short again outside off, Babar looks to upper cut it. He gets decent connection but Henry there, just ahead of the ropes takes a very good catch. Is there a twist? Or is it too late?
Bouncer! Down leg, Babar sways away from it.
Short again outside off, Hafeez cuts it to third man to get off the mark.
Mohammad Hafeez is the new man in.

OUT! Finally a wicket for New Zealand. And finally the short ball works for the Kiwis. Lockie digs it short outside off, Zaman goes for the pull but gets a top edge which balloons towards mid on. Sodhi settles under it and makes no mistake. The 101-run stand ends with Zaman falling for 88. Pakistan need more 55 runs.
Short ball outside off, Zaman hops a tad and cuts it to the man at cover-point. Good stop.
Lovely but for nothing. Pitched up ball on off, driven superbly to covers. 10 from the over.
100 partnership is up. Quicker than a run-a-ball. Down leg, helped on it's way for one.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Sounded good and gets  a boundary. Short ball outside off, Zaman pulls it front of square through mid-wicket for a boundary. The partnership is now 98*.
SHOT! Length ball outside off, Babar cuts it through backward point. The fielder chases it down and saves a run for his side. Three runs taken.
Length ball around off, Azam blocks it out with a straight bat.
Full toss outside off, Azam cuts it to third man for just one. Missed out on that one is Babar.
Fuller in length around off, Zaman looks to work it to the on side. His bottom hand comes off. They cross as the ball is away from the fielder.
Down leg, flicked to the man at square leg.
Back of a length ball down leg, tucked away to the on side for one.
Goes short again. Better execution, outside off, Azam sways away from it.
WIDE! This one is. For sure. Too short and way down leg. Babar ducks.
Short ball down leg. Babar ducks under it. The ball goes over the batsman. No wide given.
Lockie Ferguson into the attack.
Outside off, cut with force but straight to the man at point.
On the pads, worked away around the corner for one.
Fuller on middle and leg, driven towards mid on.
Zaman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. One run added to the total.
Zaman guides it to third man. They manage to come back for the second.

FOUR! Nothing is going the Kiwis' way now. Back of a length ball on off, Zaman punches it to covers. The fielder there collects it and has a shy at the non-striker's end. It doesn't hit the target and the ball runs to the mid-wicket region for a boundary. Needless to say the least.
Tim Southee in for a burst.
FOUR! Babar's turn. Short ball on middle, Babar picks up the length and pulls it with ease through the vacant mid-wicket region.  The ball races to the boundary.
Pulls this towards mid-wicket to get off strike.
Back of a length ball outside off, Zaman pulls it back to the bowler. No timing on that one.
FOUR! Very comfortable for Fakhar now. Boult strays this down leg, Fakhar helps it on it's way through square leg for back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Beauty! All timing. Didn't try and hit it hard and gets a boundary. Length ball outside off, Zaman opens the bat face and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Short ball on off, Zaman pulls it straight to the man at mid-wicket. Either side of him and that would have been runs.
Full and on off, Azam covers his stumps and blocks it out.
That ball has taken the inside edge of Babar and thudded into his pads.
Uses his feet and works it towards mid on for another run.
Played through mid-wicket by Azam to rotate strike.
Zaman gets an inside edge on that which goes fine down the leg side. One run added to the total.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Short again outside off, Zaman pulls it through mid-wicket for a brace. Good over for Pakistan, 11 from it.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Zaman. This one is short and outside off, Fakhar cuts it hard through cover-point. The ball has crossed the ropes. The umpire signals four runs.
FOUR! Lovely! Overpitched ball on middle and leg, Zaman leans forward and drives it through mid on. Ferguson there dives to his right but cannot stop the ball. It races to the fence.
Short again, this time outside off, Zaman looks to upper cut this but cannot make contact.
Short ball on leg, pulled through mid-wicket for just one.
Full on middle and leg, flicked to mid on.
Trent Boult in for another spell.
Outside off, cannot find the gap as he cuts this to the man at point.
Good length ball on leg, turned to short mid-wicket.
Strays this down leg, worked away behind square for just one.
Yorker in line of the stumps, hit back to the bowler.
Full again on off, driven nicely but straight to the man at covers.
Fuller length on off, given for the point fielder to collect.
Zaman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Leg spinner down leg. Fakhar steps out, looks to work it to the onside but flicks it to square leg. No run.
Wrong 'un outside off. Soft leading edge towards backward point.
Short ball on off, punched to long off. They jog to complete the run-a-ball 50 run stand.
Flicked through mid-wicket for one.
Leg spinner on middle, Fakhar paddles it over the keeper's head. The ball goes towards fine leg where they take another brace.
Full in line, hit back past the bowler for a run.
On a fuller length around off, comes back into Fakhar a bit who covers his stumps and blocks it out.
Azam has worked it off his pads behind square. One run added to the total.
On a good length on off, driven to covers. Dot ball.
A bit short on middle and leg, pulled to cow corner for an easy couple.
Length ball outside off, cut to the man at cover-point.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Fakhar goes back and cuts it behind point for a boundary! His 7th ODI Fifty, but first in Asia! Well played. The stand is worth 42 now, from 41 balls.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Short again, Azam goes back and punches it down to long on for a run.
Dropped short, pulled down to long on for a single.
Full and outside off, Azam leans and drives it through the covers for a single.
Short and outside off, punched straight to cover.
Ish Sodhi gets a change of ends. 2-1-6-0 so far.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Landed outside off, Azam waits for the ball to come to him and plays it very late through third man, for a couple.
Comes in with the angle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off again, punched through the covers for a single.
Outside off, punched back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, flicked through square leg for a single. The stand moves to 30 from 30 balls.
Colin de Grandhomme time.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Babar cuts it behind point and gets a  boundary! 127 more to win now, from 198 balls. Babar  has raced to 20 from 15 balls, 16 of those being in boundaries.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
FOUR! A short ball, on middle, Zaman pulls it through mid-wicket and gets a boundary!
On a length around middle, watchfully defended.
Outside off again, a slash and a miss.
On a length outside off, Zaman plays through the line and gets beaten.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and around off, driven towards long on for one.
Floated around off, the googly, Fakhar dives it towards mid off for a quick run.
WIDE. Down the leg side, Zaman looks to paddle but misses.
Short and outside off, turning away, punched through the covers for a run.
Around middle, tapped towards short mid-wicket.
Full and down the leg side, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, punched off the back foot. 10 from the over.
FOUR! LOVELY! Half volley outside off, Azam leans and drives it with perfect footwork through the covers for a boundary!
A bouncer, around off, left alone.
A short ball, around off, punched towards cover.
Fuller on middle, Babar pushes this wide of mid on for a couple. The stand moves to 10 from 13 balls.

FOUR! THE PLAN NEARLY PAYS OFF! Superb field placement and bowling from New Zealand. Williamson keeps a leg gully and asks Ferguson to bowl short. The bowler obeys and Azam instinctively pulls. Nearly gives a catch to the fielder over there who leaps but the ball evades him. 148 more needed from 215 balls.
A touch short outside off, punched straight to cover. A MAIDEN from Sodhi to start.
Floated outside leg, FZ looks to sweep but gets a bottom edge. Well stopped by Tom Latham with his right foot.
On middle and leg, driven back to the bowler.
Fuller on leg stump, flicked towards square leg.
Pitched outside leg, Fakhar gets down to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. The Kiwis appeal but it is turned down. Pitched outside leg.
Full and around middle, Zaman works it towards short mid-wicket.
Ish Sodhi introduced now.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Very straight, on a length, watchfully defended.
A length ball outside off, Azam punches it towards cover.
FOUR! Fantastic shot! A short ball outside off, Azam hops and cuts it over point for a boundary!
On a length outside off, Babar punches it through the covers but Kane Williamson dives to his left and makes a wonderful stop.
Going off, is Imam. He is walking very gingerly. Seems to be in a bit of trauma. Fakhar offers him some comforting words. Babar Azam comes in next.
Imam is getting medical attention now. Does not look good at all. The good thing though is, no bleeding is seen.

OUCH! Onto the helmet! That was quick. And Imam is down on the ground. A short ball, around off, bowled quickly at 138.3 kph, Imam looks to pull but the ball goes and hits him right between the grille and the neck. He goes down slowly and takes the helmet off.
Short and wide outside off, cut through point for a couple.
Now Imam follows suit, jumps out, takes the ball on the full and pushes it towards long on for another single.
Plenty of flight, Zaman comes down the track and drives it through the covers for one. 159 more to win from 230 balls.
Full and straight, watchfully defended
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a run. 50 COMES UP FOR PAKISTAN. Solid beginning.
On middle, punched down to long on for a single.
Interesting. Who has come on to bowl? The skipper himself. Kane Williamson to roll his arm over.
Back of a length around off, punched towards cover. Good start from Ferguson.
Down the leg side, tickled fine for a run.
Tight line, around middle, played towards short mid-wicket.
Pushes this with soft hands towards mid off and takes a quick single. FZ moves to 30 from 34 balls.
LUCKY! On a length, around middle, Fakhar is early into the tuck and gets a leading edge. Fortunately for him, the ball does not carry to cover.
A short ball outside off, Zaman looks to pull but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
POWERPLAY 2 has been signalled. 4 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till he 40th over. Here's Lockie Ferguson.

Around middle, worked straight to short mid-wicket. The announcer at the stadium eggs the crowd on to clap for Pakistan. Well, it is not often that this team has a wicketless Powerplay 1 with the bat.
Comes down the track but is not quite to the pitch of the ball. Is forced to defend.
Pushes this through mid on for a quick single.
On a length outside off, punched straight to cover.
WIDE. Down the leg side, short in length, Zaman cannot connect with his pull.
Full on middle, pushed straight to mid on.
Full and straight, watchfully defended.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.

FOUR MORE! Boult overcompensates, bowls it fuller, around middle and Zaman promptly clips it through mid-wicket for a boundary again! 168 more needed to win now, from 247 balls. The stand is worth 42 from 53 deliveries.
FOUR! Short, around middle, Zaman wastes less time in pulling that through mid-wicket for a boundary. Moves to 23 from 25 balls, with his third boundary.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Fuller, on middle and leg, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
On a length outside off, Zaman plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Tighter line, watchfully defended.
Full on middle and leg, pushed down to long on for a run.
Outside off, steered behind point for a single.
Full and straight, Zaman looked to defend but got a thick inside edge onto his pads. A quick run taken.
The batsman rocks onto the backfoot and punches the ball.
On a length outside off, steered towards third man for a single. 179 more needed to win from 257 balls.
Full and down the leg side, the southpaw misses his tuck and is hit on the pads. Boult screams his lungs out for an LBW appeal but like all other previous ones, this one was sliding down too.
FOUR! AUDACIOUS! That is rare. Imam is not known to play such shots. He runs down the track and whacks it over cover for a boundary. His first.
A bouncer, outside off, Imam sways away.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
WIDE. Misses his radar, goes down the leg side, Imam misses his flick again.
Huge shout for a caught behind, not out. Might have flicked the pad. The southpaw looked to flick but missed. There was a noise as the ball went past.
Full and around middle, Imam looks to flick but the ball moves away, takes the leading edge and goes towards mid off.
FOUR! Nice way to end the over. A short ball, down the leg side, Zaman pulls it past short fine leg for a boundary! 186 more needed to win now, from 264 balls.
Full and down the leg side, swinging down, Fakhar misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
On a length outside off, steered behind point for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Full and around leg, Zaman gives himself room to the leg side and drives it towards mid on.
Landed outside off, dabbed behind point for a single.
Full on middle, driven through mid on for a single.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
That is a beauty. Boult pitches this on a length outside off, then gets it to move away. Imam pushes but misses.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.

Massive shout for LBW. Boult is literally pleading. The umpire stays calm. Latham indicates that it might be missing leg. On a length around middle, coming in, Imam misses his flick and is hit on the pads. Hawk Eye shows that to be clipping leg stump, so umpire's call would have stayed.
Around off, solidly defended.

FOUR! Perfect placement. Not quite sure whether that was the plan though. Third man was brought up for this particular delivery but Southee bowled it short and wide. Zaman flashed at it and got it between short third man and backward point. The first boundary of the run chase.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Dropped short, pulled, not cleanly, towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, left alone.

Down the leg side again, flicked fine this time. Trent Boult gives it a good chase from long leg, dives to his left and manages to save the boundary. Three runs taken. 199 more needed from 280 balls. The stand is worth 11 from 20 balls.
Full and down the leg side, Imam looks to flick but but misses and is hit on the pads.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Full and straight, watchfully defended.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Full on middle, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
On a length around off, solidly defended.
Down the leg side, clipped fine for a single.
Short and outside of, cut straight to point. 5 dots in a row. Can he bowl a maiden?
A short ball, Zaman looks to pull but misses.
On middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket.
The batsman just manages to keep the yorker out. Good ball bowled by the bowler.
Full and down the leg side, Zaman looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Tim Southee to bowl with the second new ball.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.

HUGE SOUND! Appeal for a caught behind! But given not out! New Zealand confer but do not take the review. A length ball outside off, Imam looked to drive but missed. Now, as the ball went past the outside edge towards the keeper. However, Snickometer shows nothing! Wonder where did the sound come from...
Short and outside off, punched through point for a couple.
Played to the point region by the batsman. That's an excellent chase by the fielder. Three runs added to the total.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
On a length around middle, defended back to the bowler.

Welcome back for the run chase. 210 needed for Pakistan to level the series. Not defeated the Kiwis in 12 previous completed matches. Can they avoid an unlucky 13th? Fakhar Zaman and Imam-ul-Haq are the openers for Pakistan. The hat-trick hero of the previous game, Trent Boult, will start off proceedings to Imam. Here we go!
